note: karpenter-cost-estimate.py --nodepool apps-serving. First point with doubled tei-embeddings CPU (6/8 cores, commit 1ef1f0a). tei-embeddings peaked at 30 replicas (vs 16 at r500 with half the per-pod CPU) -- roughly proportional replica-count response given ~2x the offered rate. Despite doubled per-pod CPU, active-window p95 mean (6378ms) and especially the tail (max 51.7s vs r500's 26.1s) and error rate (4.97% avg / 35.1% peak vs r500's 0.78%/6.6%) are WORSE than r500, not better -- doubling TEI CPU did not make 1000rps sustainable, and by some measures made the failure mode more severe. Suggests the constraint at this rate may no longer be simply TEI-CPU-bound the way it was at r500; not yet investigated which component took over.
